messages:
alex: Kicking off eu-west-3 bring-up (v100 pool). Hitting repeated node bootstrap failures on the new ASGs. Anyone around?
ops-bot: CI pipeline failed: infra/provision/eu-west-3 — job #452 exited 1
sara: What error are you seeing on the nodes? can you paste the kubelet/cloud-init logs?
alex: main snippets: 
```
cloud-init[1]: failed to fetch image: unauthorized: access to registry denied
cloud-init[1]: /var/lib/cloud/instances/i-0f.../boot.log: network MTU mismatch: write: message too long
kubelet[1]: E0302 12:34:56.789 kubelet.go:123] Failed to register node: timed out waiting for the condition
```
raj: Registry auth + MTU in the same run? two independent failures could be masking each other. Did we rotate the registry token for eu-west?
marta: Looking at the cloud-init template used by the bootstrap module — I see a typo in the env block: `REGISTY_TOKEN` (missing R). That would generate an empty token when we render the file.
```
# cloud-init excerpt
write_files:
  - path: /etc/ci/env
    content: |
      REGISTRY_URL=registry.eu-west-3.example.com
      REGISTY_TOKEN=${REGISTY_TOKEN}
```
alex: ugh, so the registry login fails because of the typo. Fixing that should clear the unauthorized errors. But the MTU/overlay issue still appears in separate node logs — flannel: `failed to create vxlan device: file exists` and `fragmented packet` messages.
tim: We changed the transit gateway MTU to 1400 last week for a perf test; nodes were previously using jumbo frames (9001). CNI expects consistent MTU or will cause overlay fragmentation. Either revert TGW change or force MTU 1400 on the hosts and docker.
raj: Also noticed AWS quota for v100 in eu-west-3 is only 8 available right now. The autoscaler requested 32 nodes and got throttled; that left control plane components in a weird half-provisioned state. Looks like our quota request for the region didn't land.
sara: Summary of actionable items: 1) fix the `REGISTY_TOKEN` typo in cloud-init template (marta) 2) patch bootstrap to set docker + kubelet MTU=1400 or coordinate network team to revert TGW (tim) 3) re-submit v100 quota increase OR allow instance-family fallback in ASG (raj) 4) re-run bootstrap and smoke tests; hold rollout if any critical error 5) handoff to oncall + postmortem if rollback needed
marta: I'll open a hotfix PR to infra module `eu-west3/bootstrap` with the env var fix and cloud-init mtu change. Will link the PR in a sec.
ops-bot: deploy pipeline: starting hotfix job for refs/heads/fix/eu-west3-boot-typo
raj: note — cost team flagged eu-west-3 on-demand v100 as 2.3x our baseline. If quota is slow, should we enable fallback to p4d or g5-family for the canary pools? Need approval to change fallback policy.
alex: For immediate recovery let's rollback the partial cluster state to previous launch templates so autoscaler doesn't thrash. deploy-bot: please roll back ASGs.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for ASG eu-west3-v100-canary -> target size reverted from 16 to 0, ASG eu-west3-control-plane reverted to previous LT. ETA 90s.
ops-bot: Rollback complete: all canary instances terminated, control-plane reverted.
sara: Assigning network follow-up to tim and mavis for the TGW MTU revert. @tim can you coordinate with cloud-net?
tim: I can take it. Will ping mavis and propose reverting to 9001 for the inter-VPC link or else add MTU 1400 to host/dockerd configs.
marta: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1823 — contains the typo fix + cloud-init MTU param, and a test change to run `docker login` during init.
alex: Good. After PR merges we'll queue a controlled re-run. Re-run scheduled for 1758007200 UTC after quota update.
raj: Cost note captured in tracker (link in #finance): prefer reserved for Dedicated v100 or convert canary to cheaper gpu-family for initial smoke.
sara: After re-run, run the validation checklist: 1) registry login 2) kubelet nodejoin 3) CNI pod networking 4) autoscaler quotas 5) spot price sanity. If any fail, stop and escalate.
alex: Thanks team. Posting this to #eng-infra for visibility and will produce a short postmortem if we hit rollback again.
ops-bot: Runbook reminder created: `eu-west-3/bootstrap` — steps: bootstrap -> validate -> handoff. Owner: eng-infra oncall.
